title: 41 ferry fire victims laid to rest in Coron; 12 still missing
summary: PUERTO PRINCESA CITY—Forty-one recovered bodies were temporarily laid to rest in Barangay San Nicolas, Coron, Palawan, on Monday as search and rescue operations continued for 12 people still missing…

blocks.text: PUERTO PRINCESA CITY—Forty-one recovered bodies were temporarily laid to rest in Barangay San Nicolas, Coron, Palawan, on Monday as search and rescue operations continued for 12 people still missing after a fire struck MV June Aster while approaching Coron on Sep. 9.
